ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the efforts being made to prevent it.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
What efforts are being made to prevent Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal a larger pattern of fraud and neglect within the state's Medicaid system. By following the money and investigating the sources of fraudulent claims, we may be able to identify key players and schemes.
